name: iPhone 4
description: Apple's 2010 smartphone product architecture combining a Retina display, glass-and-stainless-steel enclosure, A4 application processor, cellular radios, cameras, battery, sensors, iOS software, and high-volume precision assembly.

targetContext.targetPerformance: high-resolution touchscreen smartphone with integrated cellular, camera, app, and media capabilities
targetContext.targetEnvironment: global consumer electronics manufacturing and carrier distribution

name: iPhone 4 Retina display stack
description: High-density LCD/touch/display module requiring cover glass, display panel, touch sensing, backlight, driver electronics, optical bonding, and final calibration.

name: A4 SoC compute subsystem
description: Application processor and memory subsystem that runs iOS, graphics, media, sensor, camera, and app workloads.

name: Cellular and RF subsystem
description: Baseband, RF front end, antennas, SIM, GPS, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and EMC integration for mobile connectivity.

name: Glass and stainless-steel enclosure
description: Front/back glass and stainless-steel structural band requiring precision machining, surface finishing, bonding, antenna isolation, and drop robustness.

name: Lithium-ion battery pack
description: Rechargeable battery pack with cell chemistry, protection circuitry, packaging, thermal limits, and safety certification requirements.
notes: Deferred fixture candidate; medium-confidence node has not been human reviewed and has no direct evidence attached.

name: Camera sensor module
description: Rear and front camera modules integrating image sensor, optics, package, autofocus or fixed-focus mechanics, image processing, and calibration.

name: iOS software stack
description: Mobile operating system, application framework, drivers, power management, media stack, browser, and App Store distribution integration.
notes: Deferred fixture candidate; medium-confidence node has not been human reviewed and has no direct evidence attached.

name: Smartphone final assembly and test
description: High-volume final assembly, adhesive/bonding, display fitting, board installation, RF test, camera calibration, functional test, and packaging flow.
notes: Unreviewed high-level process node; avoid treating it as a factory work instruction.

name: Aluminosilicate cover-glass chain
description: Strengthened cover-glass material chain from silica/alumina inputs through glass melting, sheet forming, cutting, chemical strengthening, coating, and inspection.

name: Lithium / cobalt / graphite battery material chain
description: Battery raw-material and cell-process chain including lithium salts, cobalt-bearing cathode materials, graphite anode materials, electrolyte, separator, coating, winding/stacking, formation, and testing.

name: iPhone 4 units sold
description: Adoption and production-scale proxy for the historical product.

name: Smartphone integration density
description: Proxy metric for display, battery, SoC, RF, camera, sensor, and enclosure integration in a compact handheld product.

name: GLP-1 weight-loss drugs
description: Prescription anti-obesity drug products based on GLP-1 receptor agonism, represented as a regulated pharmaceutical product family rather than a single molecule.

targetContext.targetPerformance: clinically meaningful chronic weight management benefit with acceptable safety monitoring
targetContext.targetUseCase: long-term obesity or overweight treatment under medical supervision
targetContext.targetEnvironment: regulated pharmaceutical manufacturing, prescribing, reimbursement, and pharmacovigilance

name: GLP-1 receptor agonist active ingredient
description: Peptide or incretin-mimetic active pharmaceutical ingredient that activates the GLP-1 receptor and drives appetite and metabolic effects.

name: Peptide synthesis and purification process
description: API production route using amino-acid building blocks, protected peptide synthesis or related peptide manufacturing, purification, analytical release, and batch documentation.

name: Formulation and injection delivery device
description: Finished drug formulation, sterile fill-finish, prefilled pen or injector, cold-chain packaging, instructions, and device quality system.

name: Clinical efficacy and safety package
description: Randomized clinical evidence, safety warnings, contraindications, discontinuation evidence, and long-term monitoring requirements.

name: Regulatory approval and labeling
description: Approval, indication, contraindications, warnings, medication guide, post-market monitoring, and label-change process for obesity therapeutics.

name: Amino-acid and reagent supply chain
description: Raw and intermediate chemical supply chain for protected amino acids, coupling reagents, solvents, resins, sterile excipients, and analytical reference materials.

name: Cold-chain and manufacturing capacity
description: Scale-up bottleneck covering sterile fill-finish capacity, injector-device supply, cold-chain storage, demand forecasting, and quality release.

name: Percent body-weight change
description: Clinical efficacy metric for weight-loss drug products.

metrics.name: body weight change
metrics.description: Trial endpoint comparing treatment and placebo groups.

name: Adverse event discontinuation rate
description: Safety and tolerability metric for long-term treatment adherence.

name: Reusable space transport at 1,000 USD/kg
description: A target reusable orbital transport capability/product architecture that lowers launch cost toward roughly 1,000 USD per kilogram through high reuse, rapid operations, high reliability, and large payload throughput.

targetContext.targetCost: Approximately the per-kilogram launch cost target to orbit (see reusable_space_transport_launch_cost metric for the authoritative value)
targetContext.targetPerformance: orbital payload delivery with high reuse and reliable turnaround
targetContext.targetUseCase: commercial, civil, and industrial orbital logistics
targetContext.targetEnvironment: regulated launch operations, reusable launch vehicle fleet, ground infrastructure, and range constraints

name: Reusable first-stage booster
description: Recoverable booster stage requiring restartable engines, landing guidance, thermal/structural margins, inspection access, and reflight certification.

name: Fully reusable upper stage or orbiter
description: Upper-stage/orbiter reuse branch requiring orbital reentry, thermal protection, landing, propellant management, inspection, and payload integration.

name: Methane-oxygen propulsion system
description: Reusable high-thrust propulsion stack using cryogenic propellants, turbopumps, combustion chambers, engine controllers, valves, and qualification testing.

name: Rocket engine turbomachinery
description: High-speed pumps, turbines, bearings, seals, and rotating machinery required for reusable launch propulsion.

name: Superalloy engine manufacturing
description: Engine-part manufacturing route using high-temperature alloys, precision machining, welding/brazing, additive manufacturing where appropriate, nondestructive inspection, and hot-fire qualification.

name: Thermal protection and reentry system
description: Reusable thermal protection, aerosurfaces, guidance, structural margins, inspection, repair, and reentry operations.

name: Rapid turnaround ground operations
description: Fleet operations capability covering inspection, refurbishment, propellant loading, range coordination, launch cadence, software checkout, and anomaly closure.

name: Cryogenic methane and oxygen supply chain
description: Propellant supply chain from natural-gas or methane production and air-separation oxygen through purification, liquefaction, storage, transfer, boiloff management, and launch-site handling.

name: Nickel superalloy and stainless-steel chain
description: High-temperature alloy and stainless material chain for rocket engines, tanks, structures, valves, heat shields, weld qualification, and inspection.

name: Launch cost per kilogram
description: Primary cost target for reusable space transport.

name: Reflight turnaround time
description: Time from vehicle landing/recovery to next qualified launch.

name: Commercial controlled nuclear fusion
description: A commercial electric power product/capability based on controlled fusion, requiring net plant-level energy gain, durable plasma-facing systems, tritium/fuel cycle closure, regulatory approval, maintainability, and affordable plant construction.

targetContext.targetPerformance: reliable electricity output with economically viable availability and maintenance intervals
targetContext.targetEnvironment: licensed nuclear facility with fuel-cycle, materials, and remote-maintenance constraints

name: Tokamak magnetic-confinement route
description: Fusion route using toroidal magnetic confinement, superconducting magnets, plasma heating/current drive, divertor, breeding blanket concepts, remote maintenance, and power conversion.

name: Fusion plasma confinement and control
description: Plasma stability, heating, current drive, fueling, impurity control, disruption mitigation, and diagnostic/control software needed for sustained operation.
notes: Deferred fixture candidate; medium-confidence node has not been human reviewed and has no direct evidence attached.

name: Superconducting magnet system
description: Toroidal/poloidal field coils, central solenoid, superconducting cable, cryostat, quench protection, power supplies, and cryogenic plant.

name: Plasma-facing components and divertor
description: First wall, divertor, armor, cooling channels, neutron damage tolerance, erosion control, and remote replacement strategy.
notes: Deferred fixture candidate; medium-confidence node has not been human reviewed and has no direct evidence attached.

name: Tritium breeding and fuel cycle
description: Fuel-cycle branch requiring lithium-bearing breeding material, neutron multiplier concepts, tritium extraction, inventory control, containment, and regulatory safeguards.

name: Remote maintenance system
description: Remote inspection, component replacement, hot-cell logistics, activation handling, maintenance scheduling, and plant-availability engineering.

name: Niobium-tin superconductor chain
description: Superconducting-material chain for high-field magnets, including niobium/tin feedstock, strand fabrication, cable-in-conduit conductor, heat treatment, insulation, winding, and cryogenic qualification.

name: Tungsten / lithium neutron-material chain
description: Material chain for plasma-facing armor and breeding concepts, including tungsten mining/refining/powder metallurgy, lithium-bearing ceramics or liquids, neutron irradiation testing, and compatibility screening.

name: Net electric gain
description: Plant-level metric comparing usable electric output to recirculating and input power over realistic operating cycles.

name: Fusion plant availability factor
description: Economic maturity metric for how often a plant can generate electricity after accounting for maintenance and component replacement.

name: Ultra-small nuclear reactor
description: A microreactor-class nuclear power product intended for factory fabrication, transportable deployment, long refueling intervals, passive safety, secure operation, and regulated site licensing.

targetContext.targetPerformance: passively safe, factory-fabricated, transportable, and long-interval operation
targetContext.targetUseCase: remote sites, critical infrastructure, industrial heat, defense or off-grid power
targetContext.targetEnvironment: licensed nuclear deployment with fuel qualification, security, safeguards, and waste constraints

name: Microreactor core and fuel
description: Compact reactor core and qualified fuel system, including enrichment limits, fuel form, cladding or particle fuel, burnup, heat removal, and safeguards.

name: TRISO fuel particle chain
description: Fuel-material chain for TRISO-style particles, including uranium feed, enrichment, kernel fabrication, coating layers, compaction, irradiation qualification, and quality assurance.

name: Microreactor heat transport system
description: Heat pipe, gas, molten-salt, or other heat-transport branch connecting the core to power conversion while preserving passive safety margins.

name: Power conversion module
description: Turbomachinery or engine/generator module converting heat to electricity with controls, grid interface, backup power, and maintainability constraints.

name: Factory fabrication and module QA
description: Factory-controlled nuclear module fabrication, welding, nondestructive examination, code documentation, transport preparation, acceptance testing, and traceability.

name: Licensing, security, and safeguards
description: Regulatory pathway covering safety case, emergency planning, physical security, safeguards, transportation, spent fuel, and site-specific approvals.

name: High-temperature alloy and graphite chain
description: Material chain for reactor vessel, heat exchangers, structural internals, graphite moderators or reflectors where applicable, corrosion control, irradiation qualification, and code acceptance.

name: Microreactor cost per MWe
description: Capital and lifecycle cost metric normalized by electric output.

name: Microreactor refueling interval
description: Deployment and operations metric for how long a reactor can operate before fuel replacement or return-to-factory service.

name: AK-47 rifle historical industrial case

targetContext.targetScale: large-scale historical military production and licensed or copied manufacture
targetContext.targetPerformance: robust operation, low unit cost, field maintainability, and logistics compatibility
targetContext.targetUseCase: historical industrial and standardization analysis only
targetContext.targetEnvironment: state arsenals, military logistics, and Cold War-era manufacturing systems

name: High-level operating architecture
description: Non-procedural architecture node covering reliability-oriented mechanism concepts, part standardization, tolerances, maintainability, and environmental robustness at a high level.

name: Receiver manufacturing route
description: Historical high-level route comparison between machined and stamped/fabricated receiver production as an industrial manufacturability issue, without operational dimensions or work instructions.

name: Barrel material and heat-treatment chain
description: High-level industrial node for alloy steel, forging/machining routes, heat treatment, surface protection, inspection, and proof/acceptance systems. No manufacturing parameters are modeled.

name: Stock and furniture materials
description: Wood, laminate, or polymer furniture materials and finishing processes considered as durability, climate, supply, and cost factors.

name: Interchangeability and quality system
description: Gauge, inspection, lot acceptance, standardization, training, repair logistics, and documentation system that supports mass production and field maintenance at a high level.

name: Steel sheet, forging stock, and wood/polymer chain
description: Industrial material chain for sheet steel, alloy steel forging stock, heat-treatment inputs, protective finishes, and wood/laminate/polymer furniture supply.

name: Unit cost and production rate
description: Historical industrial metrics for cost, output, standardization, acceptance rate, and logistics burden. Requires reviewed historical production evidence.

name: Field robustness metric
description: High-level robustness and maintenance metric for historical comparison; not a performance-optimization recipe.
